plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Biology A.S. Degree - Local GE' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published August 25, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7890/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: CRC Local. Total Units 61-64; lower bound 61 encoded per range rule (semester sums 15+14+16+16 = 61). Calculus track choice: MATH 400 (5 units) or MATH 355 (4 units) in Semester 1, continuing to MATH 401 (5) or MATH 356 (4) in Semester 2 — lower-credit options encoded, ranges documented in choice_notes. Semester 3 'Local Area 7B-Living Skills' 2-3 units: lower bound 2 encoded. Pre-program preparation noted per map (Intermediate Algebra, CHEM 300/305/309, MATH 373/384, MATH 120, ENGWR 300 eligibility) is placement/advisory, not sequenced; in-plan prerequisite chains (CHEM 400>401>420>421, BIOL 400>410/420) are encoded.
